Weight calibration with sum-to-one constraint research findings: 
1. Lagrange multipliers approach: Add constraint term lambda*(sum(w)-1) to objective
2. Reparameterization: Set w_K = 1 - sum(w_1 to w_{K-1}) reduces parameters by 1
3. Softmax transformation: w_k = exp(b_k)/sum_j(exp(b_j)) guarantees sum=1
4. Affine constraints like sum(w)=1 handled via Lagrange multipliers for least squares
5. Post-hoc normalization simpler but has bias-variance tradeoffs vs constrained optimization
6. Constrained optimization more principled, directly enforces requirements
